featured_reviews.name: ashok mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy experience...
Thanks doctors....

Yes my friends,
People write many nasty experience they face in hospital or with doctors. Very few write their sweet experiences in hospital or with doctors.

So I thought to share my excellent sweet experience with a small, faraway hospital but with exceptional expertise in the field of knee replacement and other orthopedic and neurological complication.

My wife Operated for knee replacement on 15th...At 11 in the morning (to 2.30 pm) including recovery time inside operation theatre...

Then shifted to ICU.
Operation was good, my wife was in jolly mood and smiling while coming out from OT after the replacement ... But after 2 hrs of shifting to ICU, the real pain started... Wife was crying like mad for pain... But through medication by 8 pm it has started reducing... and she slept.
Nxt day, 16th, morning no pain...and shifted to pvt room cabin. I also staying in the same room with her. Excellent clean cosy room with all necessary requirements like AC, TV, eye catching view from 4th floor Window, attached very clean bath (no balcony), clean and daily fresh linen.

17th.. Sr Doctors and physiotherapist started her to walk and bent the new knee to 90°...

This was regular exercise, bending knee to 90° and walking in the corridor with the help of walker and physiotherapist till 19th...

And on 19th all bandage and all drain-pipes ( 3 in total... For Blood to drain our excess blood at operated knee, one for urine, one at spinal joint to push different medicine ) removed and....
discharged in the afternoon by doctor...
Same day, 19th, came to home by evening.

She is recovering nicely.... Walking inside the flat with the help of walker... pain she feel very very rarely.

After 9th day from operation, today (24th March) was the first check up...and it is absolutely OK.
Infact, my wife walk through out the day in hospital alone with the help of walker.
Today, she has been allowed by doctor to move and do morning/evening walk with walker and asked for further check up after 15 days.
No medicine given except multivitamin for further recovery as she has no pain.

We are very very happy for the excellent smooth operation, expertise of doctors, quick recovery process with effective treatment, support of Jr. Doctors, Physiotherapist, Metron, Sisters, Brothers, room boy and aayas for 24×7 and overall management of the hospital.

Well behaved people....
No extra billing...

We, and no one, before surgery, expected that after operation on 2nd day pain would vanish... she would walk and bend knee to 90°and get discharge on 4th day...!!!

All credit goes to Dr. Rahul Bade and his team including Anesthesists Dr. Ganesh Kolhe at Sparsh Multi-Speciality Hospital.

Thank you...well done, doctor !!!
🙏🙏🙏

Thanks to Lt. Col Dr Amogh Yadav from Mumbai and Dr. Rahul Mane for strongly recomanding us the hospital.

(Note : Treatment was going on at Sanchiti Hospital. But operated at Sparsh Multi Speciality Hospital)

featured_reviews.name: Jace Seumanu (Jace Da Ace)
featured_reviews.review_text:
IndiCure Health Tours are absolutely first class in terms of their organisation & planning, as well as their communication level. Once I had made the decision to go ahead with my treatment (which was significantly cheaper compared to the same services offered in Australia), IndiCure handled all of the logistics for me, in terms of the visa application & confirming my hotel stay in India. (I chose the hotel after being presented with a substantial number of options by IndiCure.)

After I booked my return flights, everything else was handled by IndiCure; most notably, my cab rides to & from the hospital & the hotel for the duration of my stay, which I found incredibly helpful,  since it was my first time to Mumbai, let alone the country.

My initial inquiry was handled by Dr Ruchika Malhotra & she was mostly responsible for the consistency of communication all the way through. My surgeon Dr Shraddha Deshpande & her team were amazing & completed my two procedures without any complications at all. (Incidentally, the cost of my two treatments cost less than $AUD10,000; one of the treatments being a septo-rhinoplasty too!)

And then, during my pre-op consultation & post-op recovery, Ms Vismaya Pillai, one of IndiCure's Customer Experience officers, was also instrumental in ensuring my recovery was on track. She was constantly checking on me during the near two weeks I was in Mumbai, & she even visited me at my hotel to again check on my progress, & also to present a small Xmas Gift pudding on Xmas Eve which was incredibly thoughtful, especially since I was in Mumbai on my own & without my family!

The nurses & administration staff at Wockhardt Hospital in central Mumbai, were absolutely wonderful too. Their care & attention that they showed me in the 3 days following my surgery & before I relocated to the hotel for the remainder of my stay in Mumbai, was world class! I never felt neglected & the professionalism that they displayed was phenomenal! Another impressive feature of IndiCure's service is the meticulous collation of your pre- & post-op medical information & scans etc, which you're presented with for you to take home. And this only serves to prove the level of efficiency & care that they provide to each patient.

I thoroughly endorse & recommend IndiCure Health Tours if you're seriously considering undergoing any type of medical treatment(s). Please feel free to contact me directly if you need to verify or clarify anything in relation to the above. IndiCure Health Tours is a truly world class organisation... can't wait to visit Mumbai again in the future!!!

featured_reviews.name: Ariana McCahill
featured_reviews.review_text:
While waiting on the New Zealand waiting list for a hip replacement, I came across an article from Claire Olsen who had been to Mumbai, India to have a double hip replacement with IndiCure and Wockhardt Hospital.
From the time I made contact with IndiCure, The team were nothing but helpful and informative, they took all my information that I had which were only x-rays and showed them to the surgeon, Dr Mudit Khanna.  IndiCure then came up with a surgical plan, gave me costings and accommodation options. Once I had made up my mind about going to India for the surgery, the IndiCure team helped with a Visa for both me and my travelling companion.
They sent me through my surgical itinerary which included pick up from airport to the hotel I had chosen. This was really good information as they send a photo of your driver to help identify who is picking you up from the airport.
Any time I needed to go to the hospital for pre-op test or for the surgery or for post-op test, IndiCure always supplied a driver to and from each destination.
Prior to surgery IndiCure were also able to provide a driver, so my companion and I could see the sites of Mumbai.
On arrival to Wockhardt hospital,  Vismaya was here to greet me and stayed with me through all my pre-op tests.
On admission to Wockhardt hospital, Khushboo was with me every step of the way, always checking in each day after surgery to make sure I was comfortable, if I needed anything, she was always so accommodating when I did need things, nothing but first class service from Khushboo and the team at IndiCure.
I chose to travel to Mumbai during the Christmas break, and even received a little Christmas cake from the IndiCure team, which was so awesome.
Miss Chhaya was our  main driver and was exceptional, if you’ve ever driven in India you will understand.
All the team speak English and nothing is too much hassle for them.
Genuine people looking after all types of medical needs for international travellers.
I highly recommend IndiCure and all the services they provide

featured_reviews.name: Martin Kinney
featured_reviews.review_text:
I engaged with Indicure via Google search as I was looking to alternatives to a long duration of waiting for hip replacement surgery in NZ.

In closing, I highly recommend Indicure for all those seeking medical attention as an international patient.
